name: Archaeological Site of Ani
description: Ani is a ruined medieval city on a windswept plateau in northeast Türkiye, above a gorge that marks the border with Armenia. In the 10th and 11th centuries it was the Armenian Bagratid capital, rich from Silk Road trade. Today you can wander among roofless churches, a grand cathedral and crumbling walls, all standing in open grassland since the 1319 earthquake.
